_about: Settings of the waterbody-impact module: how an intervention's effect on a waterbody's seasonal water is estimated. Read by seft/impact and core_seft. See knowledge/impact/README.md.

intervention_types.label: Desilting
intervention_types.about: Silt excavated from the waterbody bed, usually in modules of about 10,000 m3, before the monsoon.
intervention_types.headline: W

year_convention: Hydrological years start in June and are named by their first calendar year (2023 = 2023-24). Work is done before the monsoon, so an intervention in year Y has Y, Y+1, ... as post years and Y-1 and earlier as pre years.

outcomes.label: Weeks of water
outcomes.about: Each season is about 17 weeks; a waterbody wet in all three seasons over its whole maximum area scores 52. The seasonal analogue of mean weeks of water.

outcomes.label: Rabi retention
outcomes.about: Share of the monsoon fill still holding water in rabi. Undefined when the kharif fill is under 10% of the maximum area.

outcomes.label: Summer retention
outcomes.about: Share of the monsoon fill still holding water in summer (zaid).

matching.about: Controls are untreated waterbodies of the same atlas type within radius_km, outside the treated waterbody's own MWS and more than exclude_near_treated_m from any waterbody treated in the estimate's window, nearest by Mahalanobis distance on the features. Waterbodies treated later than the window are valid controls (not yet treated).

estimators.label: Rainfall-matched post minus pre, no controls
Counterfactual model on the pre years

reference.about: Untreated waterbodies of the same district and type, run through the same pipeline as if treated in the same year with the same post years. Fewer than min_n of the type: all in-scope types of the district.

verdict.about: A likely gain or loss with fewer than min_post_years_full years of data after the work is shown as an early sign.

small.label: under 0.5 ha: the water classifier is least reliable

flow_driven.label: water follows river flows or canal releases

one_post_year.label: only one year after the work

unscreened.label: controls not screened for other interventions (no registry for this area)

labels.match_far: linked to a waterbody more than 30 m away
labels.volume_implausible: silt volume implies more than 2 m depth over the waterbody
labels.type_out_of_scope: waterbody type is out of the atlas scope
labels.below_min_area: waterbody below the atlas minimum area
labels.unlinked: not linked to an atlas waterbody

averages.about: Averages use assessable single or first windows without record-quality flags. A unit is flagged when its placebo estimates average at least placebo_concern_weeks in size, or their 95% range excludes zero. For a waterbody note the comparison group is its district and type if it has min_n works, else its rainfall regime and type, else its type.
